narration:1:1620975001:1.text: Cards flip. Time flows. With the funeral arrangements piling up, Zorya excuses herself first.

narration:2:1620975002:1.text: You agree to meet again tomorrow at noon in the cemetery for the promised tea gathering...

narration:3:1620975003:1.text: Several rounds follow. And more. Enough that you start to suspect you're slowly being shuffled into the deck... Here comes Cassadee with her tea.

say:5:1620975004:0.text: I'm so sorry to keep you waiting. I completely lost track of time...
say:5:1620975004:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，娑丽丝老师！对不起，我做实验的时候忘记注意时...

say:5:1620975004:0.female: I'm so sorry to keep you waiting. I completely lost track of time...

say:6:1620975005:0.text: I thought it over, and I'm convinced a magical approach to the recipe is the only way to brew an extraordinary herbal tea.
say:6:1620975005:0.source_cn: 我想了想，果然还是配方应该以魔法的方式解读，才能调配出...

say:7:1620975006:0.text: First, I made a carbon tablet and shaped it into a leaf using magic.
say:7:1620975006:0.source_cn: 叶子的部分，我用魔法制作出了一片浓缩物质，将它捏成了叶...

say:8:1620975007:1.text: Drop it in before you drink, and it dissolves and fizzes beautifully! Also, it has a crisp taste, perfect for cold brew.
say:8:1620975007:1.source_cn: 喝之前放入茶水中，会在水里重新溶解为气泡，声音就像唱歌...

say:9:1620975008:1.text: As for the flower, I used moon pomelo flowers and moon crystal powders—more depth, more brightness, more "moon". And liquid gold... Well, I like honey, so I kept it.

say:10:1620975009:1.text: And with moon crystal powders it comes with a unique property: it refreshes the mind and greatly improves study efficiency and casting success rates!

say:11:1620975010:0.text: Well done, Cassadee. Now, you have your own version of extraordinary herbal tea.
say:11:1620975010:0.source_cn: 你做得很好，科丝蒂。现在，你终于也找到独属于自己的神奇...

narration:13:1620975012:1.text: Solise and you drink Cassadee's tea.

say:14:1620975013:0.source_cn: ……咳……咳咳咳……怎、怎么这么……这么甜……咳咳咳……

say:15:1620975014:1.text: Oh, I should've said. Pushing the refreshing note too hard made it a little bland, so I added a proper amount of honey on top of the base recipe.
